xe: xe — they; x- completive + e 'they', before an intransitive verb (xe na'ojinik 'they pondered'); also xe' 'root' in the title line · xe' — the foot, the bottom of (a tree, a mountain, a ravine); xe' 'root, foot', before the noun · xe — x- completive + e 'them', the object before a transitive verb (inferred; mi xe a calaba 'have you ruined them')
opon: opon — arrive (there); verb, arriving at a place away from the speaker (ul is 'arrive here')
puch: puch — also, and; particle tagging the second of a pair
cuꜭ: kuk' — with them; ruk' 'with him' with 3pl prefix · quk' — with us; q- 'our' (qa- before a vowel) + uk' 'company'
que: ke — thus, as; adverb of manner · ke — k- 'ongoing' + e 'they', before a verb (xa ke wachelajik 'they kept on screeching') · qe — for us (uncertain); qa- 'our, us' set (tzuqul qe, k'o'l qe) · ke — of them (banol ke 'maker of them'), compare kech · ke — k- 'ongoing' + e 'them', the object before a transitive verb (ke qa chak 'we defeat them', qa- 'we') · qe — us (the object after an agent noun, camol qe 'taker of us'); q- 'we, us' + e · ke — (unclear) a particle written apart before a verb, left unrendered (ke chab'iyj 'you tell'); before waj 'hide' perhaps carrying the e of ewaj (inferred) · qe — ours; q- 'we, us' + e, standing alone as 'ours' (va que 'this one of ours', ri que 'ours', of the ball); Brasseur va ke 'la nôtre'
chic: chik — now, already, also; adverb of changed state · chik — any more (mawi xki nataj chik 'they no longer remembered'); in their turn, also
chi: chi — at, in, to; preposition (also optative 'let' before a verb) · chik — again: chic with its final c shared with the next word (xki chi k'ut, xech'a chi k'u) · chi — with, of (chi ixim 'with maize'); also 'that' before a verb (chi qajaj 'that we carve') · chi' — mouth (ca chi 'our mouth', qui chi 'their mouths'); noun, same letters as the preposition · chi — ch- (command) + i- 'you (pl.)', before a verb · chik — any more (ꜭo chi vi 'is there any more'); chic with its c not written · chi — from (xe el chi kochoch 'they went out from their home'); also a particle written apart before a verb or noun that is not clear and is left unrendered (chi petik 'coming', chi ki b'ano 'they did it', xere chi wa 'only this') · chi — (unclear) a particle before a verb in we chi chaqi'jik 'if it dries' and ta chi pe utux 'when its shoot comes', carrying the conditional sense, left unrendered; also chi' 'mouth' in pu chi' 'in the mouth' (pu 'in'), and chi 'at' in chi malmat 'wriggling' (unclear) · chik — again, in turn: chic with its final c not written (xe icou chi vi cut 'they passed again there', ma chi vi xꜭhavic 'again it did not speak', xꜭha chi roo culel 'said again the fifth seated one'); also in Are chi cu ri 'and as for the cigar'
qui: ki — their; 3pl possessive/ergative prefix · ki — k- 'ongoing' + i- 'you (pl.)', written qui like the prefix 'their'; also k- + i(n) 'I' (inferred) · ki — fermented drink (inferred); noun, in qa ki 'our drink', after Brasseur · ki — how, so (inferred); a word of degree before utz 'good' · qi — truly (qi tzij 'truly'); written apart from tzij 'word', as qui ꜩih, after Brasseur's quitzih · ki — they (inferred); the person of the verb in qui caiih 'they look at it', as Brasseur reads it · ki — (inferred) sweet, glad (modern ki'), in qui qui ꜭux 'their heart (was) sweet', glad, read with Brasseur's quiy; the letters respelled · ki — (unclear) a particle in questions and before cu, pu (Apa qui xe pe vi 'where have they come from', Qui cu are), left unrendered
la: la — unexplained particle in kat kix la uloq; uncertain · la — you, Your Lordship, a respectful form (chi la 'to you'; inferred from Brasseur's note); particle · la — (uncertain) kept apart from pis 'wrap' (chi ki pis la ki wi' 'they wrapped their heads', after Brasseur); not clear
vach: wach — face (also eye, fruit); noun, root of uwach (ki wach 'their face')
oponic: oponik — arrived there; opon 'arrive there' + -ik, the ending of an intransitive verb (xe oponik pa … 'they arrived in …')
xqui: xki — they (did it); x- completive + ki- 3pl ergative, prefix before a transitive verb · xki — you (pl.) (doubtful); in xqui zachic, xqui ca cup, as the parallel with quix camic requires; printed as written
quib: kib' — themselves, one another; ki- 'their' + -ib' reflexive · qib' — ourselves; q- 'our' (qa- before a vowel) + ib' reflexive
quih: kij — its juice (inferred); written qu + i as Brasseur's quih, not q'ij 'day' · q'ij — (inferred) sun, day; in tikil q'ij 'noon', the planted sun (Brasseur gih, 'à midi précis'), written with plain qu where the house word is ꜫih; the toggle restores the q' · q'ij — day; ki q'ij 'their day', the day fixed for them (xchoye k'u kanoq ki q'ij 'their day was set'), written qui quih with plain qu; Brasseur reads qui gih · kij — (guess) their back; taken as qui ih (ki- 'their' + ij 'back') written as one word; Brasseur's print unclear
vi: wi — there, here, in it; locative particle (points back to a place or time) · wi' — head, top (pa ki wi' 'on their heads') · wi — part of wikiq'ab' 'right (hand)' (inferred), written apart (vi qui cab, set against mox 'left')
meba: meb'a' — poor, orphaned; the word is certain (modern meb'a', Brasseur 'orphelins')
ta: ta — then, when, so that; particle introducing a following clause, also marks wishes/purpose · ta — hear, understand; transitive verb (xki ta 'they heard') · ta — after mawi, marks the negation (mawi utz ta chuxoq 'it is not good that it be'); particle · ta — (inferred) a softening particle: chi kunaj ta na 'let (it) be healed, please first', and in ta on 'perhaps, rather' (as on 'perhaps')
xꜩonox: xtzonox — it was asked; x- completive + tzonoj 'ask' + passive -x
cut: k'ut — then, and so; narrative connective particle · k'ut — show; transitive verb (xqui cut v vach 'they showed their faces'), the same letters as the connective cut 'then'
cahau: kajaw — father; noun, paired with chuch
apa: apa — where; interrogative adverb, asks the place · apa — who; in apa china 'who (are they)', where the pair is read together (inferred)
quix: kix — you all (with an ongoing/commanded action); k- + ix 'you (pl.)' · kix — (uncertain) a verb after kat, 'be ashamed' or 'prick' (inferred), in kat kix la uloq · k'ix — thorn; noun (chuvi quix 'on top of thorns'), not the quix 'you (pl.)'
vꜭhaxic: uch'axik — its being told, being spoken to; u- 'its' + ch'a(w) 'speak' + passive -x + -ik · uch'axik — being called (kix uch'axik 'you shall be called')
maba: mab'a — not (in a question, with doubt); ma (question) + b'a
ahau: ajaw — lord, ruler; noun, a title
maui: mawi — not, no; negative particle, before a noun or verb
xquetamah: xketamaj — they knew it; x- completive + k- (qui- 3pl ergative before a vowel) + etamaj 'know'
v: u — its; possessive prefix (Ximénez writes v), as in v xe 'its root'
ca: qa — we, our; qa- 'our' or 'we' before a verb · ka — (uncertain) in que ka k'o, 'there will yet be'; k- 'ongoing' + a · ka — k- 'ongoing' before a verb or state word, written apart (ka pichipoj '(they) are pichipoj', uncertain; ma ka jisaj, k- + a- 'you') · ka — second (inferred); kab' 'second' written without its b', as uka 'a second (pit)' · ka — (unclear) a particle before a verb or a word of state, left unrendered
oc: oq — yet, still; adverb of continuing state · ok — enter; verb (que rah oc pa hul 'they want to enter a hollow') · -oq — ending after a verb of motion marking the direction, written apart (apon oq 'arrive there') · oq — now, then; a particle of urging after an imperative or question (kach'aw oq 'speak now', katzijon oq 'tell it then'), after Brasseur 'Parle donc'
camic: kamik — died, dying; cam 'die' + -ic (xoh camic 'we died')
xa: xa — only, just, merely; particle · xa — you (did); x- completive + a- 'you', before a verb (xa riqo 'you found it'), the same letters as xa 'only'
xeꜭha: xech'a — they spoke; x- completive + e- 'they' + ch'a(w) 'speak'
naquila: naqila — anything, something; indefinite pronoun · naqila — what (in a question, mi xki kulwachij 'what have they met'); same word as the indefinite
biyh: b'iyj — say, tell; the verb b'ij 'say' with its letters in another order, as in xchicabyih
bala: b'ala — unexplained (Brasseur 'at their ease'); uncertain · b'ala — here 'very well' after utz (Utz b'ala 'very well', after Brasseur 'C'est fort bien'); inferred · b'ala — (inferred) indeed; strengthens the word before it (qitzij b'ala 'truly indeed')
ban: b'an — do, make; root of the verb, here with x- completive and ki- 3pl: 'they did'
ba: b'a — particle of urging; not otherwise explained · b'a — (inferred) pointing, 'over there, look', after chila' 'there'
cay: kay — (inferred) watch, look; verb, and as a noun 'watching' (xa qui cay 'they watch', ca cay 'our watching'); in xa chi mach cay not understood
naqui: naqi — what; interrogative, written with pa as naqi pa 'what is it'
yao: yao — give; ya 'give' + -o, the ending of a transitive verb (xu yao 'it gave')
cah: kaj — sky (also 'four' in the cord passage); noun · qaj — we want; q- 'we' (before a vowel) + aj 'want', as xkaj 'they wanted' · qaj — go down, descend (inferred); verb, as in qajik 'descending' · kaj — (inferred) they want; k- (ki- 'they' before a vowel) + aj 'want', after chi of wishing (chi kaj ta 'let them be willing'); the same letters as qaj 'go down' · kaj — four; numeral, the root of kajib' (kaj tzel 'four bowls')
xibih: xib'ij — frighten; verb (ka xib'ij rib' 'it frightens itself', xib'ij qib' 'we frighten ourselves')
chire: chire — to him, to her; chi + r- 'him/her' + e · chire — at his teeth (inferred); chi + r- 'his' + e 'tooth' · chire — because, for; conjunction (chire lib'ajchi 'because quickly')
mi: mi — now, just now; particle, as mi- in mixutzinik · mi — (inferred) do not, before a verb (mi xb'isonik 'do not grieve', after Brasseur 'ne vous affligez pas'); the form is not clear · mi — (guess) not, in mi na re 'not even' (mi na re xkuyu 'not even … was spared'), after Brasseur 'On n'a même pas épargné'
mix: mix — has just; mi- 'just now' + x- completive · mix — do not (inferred); mi + ix 'you (pl.)' before a verb (mix okik 'do not weep') · mix — you (pl.) have; mi- 'just now' + ix 'you (pl.)' before a verb, the completive x- merged with it (inferred; mix ya 'you (pl.) have let (it be)')
are: are — this is, it is; demonstrative/copula pointing forward
xah: xaj — dance; verb (xqui xah 'they danced'), the root of xahoh 'dance' and xahol 'dancer'
ri: ri — the, that (definite article/relative marker, e.g. ri Tepew 'the Sovereign'); particle
puzu: pusu — (inferred) sacrifice; pus, the word set beside nawal in the first part (sense uncertain, often connected with sacrifice), + -u; after Brasseur ('sacrifions-les')
curi: k'uri — then, and so; k'u 'then' + ri, narrative connective
ronohel: ronojel — all, everything; quantifier, r- + onojel
coh: koj — we, us (shall); k- 'shall' + oj 'we, us', before a verb (koj isik'ij 'you shall call on us') · koj — we, us (ongoing); k- 'ongoing' + oj 'we, us' (coh icuxih 'you chased us') · koj — put, place; transitive verb (inferred) · koj — (inferred) puma; noun, as ꜭoh (Brasseur 'Lion'), written with plain c and the same letters as koj 'we' · koj — put on, apply; xki koj chi uwach 'they put it on its face', after Brasseur 'l'appliquèrent à l'oeil'
tah: taj — let it be, may it; Classical optative particle (in modern K'iche' taj is a negative) · taj — the second part of the negative ma ... taj 'not' (ma nab'e ki chakatajik taj 'not first their being brought low') · taj — (unclear) a particle after a completed verb (xki majix taj), left unrendered · taj — (unclear) a particle after waral 'here' and chawaj 'you want' (waral taj koj chaaj wi 'here we shall play'), left unrendered; also the second part of mana … taj 'not … nor' (mana pa juyub' taj)
ꜭux: k'u'x — heart; noun (ki k'u'x 'their heart'); root of Uk'u'x · k'ux — (inferred) gnaw, saw; the letters of k'u'x 'heart' as a verb (ca ꜭux qui he 'gnawing their tails'), after Brasseur 'scier'
be: b'e — road, path; noun · b'e — go (chi b'e 'that we go'); verb, the root of xb'e 'he went'
tac: taq — plural marker 'various, several'; particle placed before a noun · taq — send; transitive verb (xki taq 'they sent')
rumal: rumal — by, because of, through; relational noun r- 'its' + umal 'cause, agent'
ya: ya — give; verb (ku ya 'he gives') · ya — river, water (inferred, after Brasseur); noun, the letters respelled as written · ya — put, set; the 'give' verb used of placing a thing (qui ya 'they put it', chi ya chuvi ꜫaꜫ 'put it on the fire')
vꜭhax: uch'ax — (were) told, spoken to; u- + ch'a(w) 'speak' + passive -x, as in xe uch'ax 'they were told'
tiquiba: tikib'a' — plant, begin (inferred; 'planting the day' taken as laying out the count of days); verb, as in xchiqatikib'a' in the preamble
xul: xul — it arrived; x- completive + ul 'arrive'
xibalba: Xib'alb'a — Xibalba; the world below, the realm of the lords of death, which the missionaries took for 'hell' (Brasseur's note); kept as a name · Xib'alb'a — the people of Xibalba, its lords and inhabitants together (xeꜭha Xibalba 'Xibalba said', ronohel Xibalba 'all Xibalba')
e: e — they; plural marker before a noun or verb · e — tooth, teeth; noun (also in we 'my teeth', re 'his teeth')
xaho: xajo — dance it; xaj 'dance' + -o, the ending of a transitive verb (xqui xaho 'they danced it')
cux: Kux — Cux; name of a dance, Brasseur: a kind of weasel; not checked
puhuy: Pujuy — Puhuy; name of a dance, Brasseur: a long-eared owl; not checked
yboy: Yb'oy — Yboy; name of a dance, the armadillo (modern iboy)
xꜭha: xch'a — said; x- completive + ch'a 'say', the singular of xech'a
cu: k'u — then, so; narrative connective, variant of k'ut · ku — k- 'ongoing' + u- 'he', written cu like the particle (cu nimarizah rib 'he makes himself great') · ku — (unclear) in cul qui cu, left unrendered; Brasseur prints qul qui qu
chique: chike — to them; chi 'to' + ke 'them' · chiqe — to us (inside speech); chi + qe 'us' (Ximénez's qu stands for both k and q; the toggle shows chiqe) · chike — (guess) a verb after xe, 'leaned (?)', in xe chique chuvi 'they leaned (?) over it'; not clear; Brasseur 'se tournèrent … vers le parfum'
nu: nu — my; 1sg possessive · nu — I; ergative prefix before a verb (ka nu tao 'I hear it', ka nu riqo 'I find it')
caztah: k'astaj — (inferred) come alive, revive; k'as 'live' (root of k'aslem 'life') + -taj 'become'; the restored k' is inferred from the known root
ivumal: iwumal — by you (pl.); i- 'you (pl.)' + umal, the umal of rumal 'by, because of'
ve: we — if, whether; conjunction · we — (uncertain) teeth, following Brasseur ('my teeth shine'), in nay pu ve raxcavacoh · we — yes; particle (Brasseur 'yes') · we — my teeth; w- 'my' + e 'tooth'
puz: pus — sacred power (exact sense uncertain); often connected with sacrifice · pus — (inferred) sacrifice, be sacrificed; xe puz 'they were sacrificed', Brasseur 'sacrifiés'
quicot: kikot — rejoice; verb root kikot 'be glad', as in xkikot 'they rejoiced' (after ke 'they (ongoing)')
chu: chu — at, by its (before a noun); let it (before a verb); chi 'at' + u- 'its' (chu jutaq chob'il 'by each division'), or ch- 'let' + u- 'it' (chu riqo 'let it find') · chu — he, it, before a verb; ch- + u- 'he', without the sense 'let' (chu maijaj 'he marvels') · chu — (inferred) ch- + u-, singular, with plural doers named after the verb (are puch chu sik'ij ri ajsib', ajkot 'the painters and carvers call on them too')
na: na — now, then; particle · na — still; particle · na — feeling, sense (inferred); na 'feel', the root of nao · na — (inferred) first, for the time being; as in oh na 'we first'
pa: pa — in, at; preposition · pa — question particle after mi, 'has it…?' (mi pa xutzin 'has he finished?') · pa — after naqi, 'what (is it)?' (naqi pa); a particle of the question · pa — question particle after other words too: ma pa 'is it not that …?', ꜭo chi pa 'is there still …?'
ha: ja' — water; noun · ja — house (modern ja; que rah acanic chuvi ha 'they want to climb on the house') · ja — go! (a command, inferred, after Brasseur)
conohel: konojel — all of them; ki- 'their' made k- before a vowel + onojel, as ronojel is r- + onojel
mana: mana — not; negative, a form of ma
huzu: jusuk — suddenly, at once; adverb (Ximénez's huzu is huzuc with its c shared with the next word cu)
zachic: sachik — loss, undoing; sach 'be lost' + -ik, verbal noun
huncame: Junkame — Huncame, One Death; name of a lord of Xibalba; jun 'one' + kame 'death' (kam 'die'), a day name; kept as a name
maihah: maijaj — wonder at, marvel (inferred); after Brasseur ('était émerveillé')
xere: xere — just so, this is how, only this; adverb
xahouic: xajowik — dancing; xajoj 'dance' (modern) respelled by the letters + -ik (ke xajowik 'they dancing')
nim: nim — great, big; adjective · nim — (inferred) respect, honour; nim 'great' made a noun or verb, in ki nim 'their respect'
camizah: kamisaj — kill; kam 'die' + -is-, which makes 'cause to ...', + -aj, so 'make die'
ma: ma — not, nor, or (in a question); negative/interrogative particle
chap: chap — seize, catch; verb, the root of chapo and chapon
cate: k'ate — then, only then; narrative particle
vꜭux: Uk'u'x — its heart; u- 'its' + k'u'x 'heart, centre'; in Uk'u'x Kaj 'Heart of Sky'
coloba: kolob'a — (guess) set it in place; kol 'set, put in place' (?) + -oba, the root perhaps of xucolo and colom; Brasseur leaves it out; respelled by the letters
came: Kame — Came, Death; kam 'die', the day Death (Brasseur), in Wuqub' Kame 'Seven Death', a lord of Xibalba; kept as a name
cumal: kumal — by them; r- 'by' form rumal with 3pl ki- · qumal — by us; r- 'by' form rumal with qa- 'we' (Brasseur kumal, his k is q)
quil: kil — it is seen (inferred); il 'see' with k-, in xa k'o kil kakiye; not clear · kil — (inferred) hold back; in xqui quil quib 'they held one another back', after Brasseur ('defending themselves')
raih: raij — it wants, desire (inferred); r- + aij 'desire', as in rraij; after Brasseur ('convoite') · raij — want (inferred); with ka- 'you' (ca raih 'you want') and with nu- 'I' (ca nu raih 'I want it'), so the r belongs to the stem here; after Brasseur ('désires', 'j'en veux')
i: i — your (pl.); 2pl possessive prefix, as in i poy 'your effigies' · i — i- 'you (pl.)' before a verb, the ergative (i vila 'you see it', with w- before a vowel); said to one person out of respect (inferred)
xhunahpu: Xjunajpu — Hunahpu; name, written with x- (Brasseur: diminutive 'the younger Hunahpu')
xbalanque: Xb'alanke — Xbalanque; name of the second of the two boys, with Hunahpu; make-up uncertain (Brasseur: x- diminutive + balam 'jaguar')
vcab: ukab' — its second; u- 'its' + kab' 'two', ordinal · uq'ab' — his hand, his arm; u- 'his' + q'ab' 'hand', cab written with plain c (racan vcab 'his legs, his arms')
xel: xel — it went out, they went out; x- completive + el 'go out', with no -ik because more follows in the clause
nah: naj — far; adverb (chi nah 'from far off')
xcotix: xkotix — (?) was carved; perhaps the root of modern k'ot 'carve', plain c, + -ix passive (inferred)
vloc: uloq — hither, this way; adverb with verbs of coming
chuvach: chuwach — on the face of; chi + u- 'its' + wach 'face', relational noun
ꜩalic: tzalik — (?) grasses; not otherwise known (k'o xa tzalik 'there are only tzalik'); respelled by the letters
rahaual: rajawal — its lords, the lords of; r- 'its' + ajaw 'lord' + -al
banouic: b'anowik — do, did it, with the doers named; b'an 'do' + -ow, the ending that names the doers, + -ik, as xb'anowik (xe b'anowik 'they were the ones who did it')
nao: nao — feel, know; nau 'know, feel' with the transitive -o (xca nao 'we felt')
pu: pu — also, and; short form of puch · pu — in, at (inferred); pa 'in', in pu chi' 'in the mouth' · pu — in its, in the; pa 'in' + u- 'its' contracted (Brasseur: pu for pa u, p'u 'dans le'), as pu b'eal 'by the road', pu wi' ja 'in the top of the house'
ꜩih: tzij — word, speech, account; noun · tzij — (inferred) kindle, light; xqui ꜩih ri chah 'they lit the torch', as 010's ꜩihom 'lit'
xecha: xecha — they said; x- completive + e- 'they' + cha 'say'
ꜭaztah: k'astaj — come to life, revive; k'as 'live' + -taj; written with the cuatrillo, and also caztah with plain c
ꜭo: k'o — there is, exists; existential verb
cam: k'am — take; verb · kam — die; verb · kam — (guess) take part; the letters of k'am 'take' as written, in ꜭo cam cu raih 'who are there to take part', after Brasseur's qam; not 'die'
ive: iwe — you (pl.); iw- 'your (pl.)' + e, the form seen in chiwe 'to you'
ꜭahol: k'ajol — son, child (of a man); noun
vbi: ub'i' — its name, called; u- 'its' + b'i' 'name', possessed noun
cacan: kaqan — their legs, their feet; k- (ki- 'their' before a vowel) + aqan 'leg, foot'
xquil: xkil — they saw; x- completive + ki- 'they' + il 'see', without the -o of xkilo
cabichal: kab'ichal — (uncertain) meaning not known; paired with telen, the pair read 'on the shoulder' after Brasseur; the letters respelled · kab'ichal — (inferred) the two of them, together; after Brasseur 'à l'un ou à l'autre'
cahizabal: kajisab'al — means of bringing down; kaj 'go down' + -isa 'make' + -b'al
xbanic: xb'anik — it was made; x- completive + b'an 'make' + passive -ik
xoc: xok — entered; x- completive + ok 'enter' · xoq' — cried (out); x- completive + oq' 'cry, weep', written with plain c (Brasseur x-og), the tresillo restored; not the xok 'entered'
xuculu: Xukulu — unknown word (uncertain); printed as one word, left untranslated
tocob: toq'ob' — pity; noun or verb root, as in toq'ob' nu wach 'pity my face'
xu: xu — it (did); x- completive + u- 'it', singular of xki
rib: rib' — itself; reflexive noun r- 'its' + ib' 'self'
quiz: k'is — finish, end; verb (xki k'is 'they finished') · k'is — (inferred) completely, all; the verb k'is 'finish' as an adverb (k'is yakatajinaq chik 'all had risen up again')
bec: b'ek — go; b'e 'go' with -ek (inferred), as in kat b'ek 'you go'
tubul: tub'ul — weak, giving way, tottering (inferred); after Brasseur ('chancelant des pieds et des mains')
vla: ula — hither, coming; adverb with verbs of coming
chacatahic: chakatajik — being brought low; the verbal noun of chakataj 'bring low' (inferred), as in vchacatahic
halvachibal: jalwachib'al — likeness, a changed face; jal 'change' + wach 'face' + -ib'al, ending of means (inferred)
bano: b'ano — do, make; b'an 'do, make' + -o, the ending of a transitive verb (xki b'ano 'they made it')
